responsibility: Contains the FR-V RTL machine description: the target’s instruction patterns, expands, splitters, attributes, unspec codes, pipeline-visible instruction types, and scheduling/packing metadata. It defines how generic RTL operations and FR-V-specific builtins, PIC/FDPIC relocations, TLS sequences, media operations, branches, loads/stores, and VLIW packetable instructions are recognized and emitted as FR-V assembly, while also supplying the cpu/type attributes that drive scheduling and resource selection.
same_name_distinction: RTL machine-description file for FR-V: unlike frv.cc and frv.h, it encodes define_insn/define_expand patterns, attributes, unspec values, and scheduling/packing rules that map GCC RTL and FR-V builtins onto concrete instruction forms; unlike frv.opt, it is about instruction semantics rather than option parsing.
